## Checklist
- [ ] Focused change, linked to an issue (for anything non-trivial)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `uv run --extra dev --extra mcp pytest -q` passes
- [ ] `uv run --extra dev ruff check src tests` is clean
- [ ] Tests don't depend on installed tools or the network
- [ ] No new dependency in the core CLI
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` (`Unreleased`) updated
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, personal paths or private screenshots
